trademark-detail.eventDescription: Charged per result when enrichDetails is enabled — one extra TMview detail request that adds registration & expiration dates, opposition periods, full goods & services descriptions per Nice class, detailed applicant info (address, nationality), legal representatives and renewal history.

Screening triage, not legal advice. Charged ON TOP of trademark-result only when the user opts into AI clearance (paying plans).

currentPricingInfo.reasonForChange: 2 new optional events: applicant->company link ($0.005, FR-resolved only) and AI brand-clearance / likelihood-of-confusion ($0.02/mark). Both OFF by default, billed only if enabled - the base $0.01/result and the $0.01 detail event are unchanged.
